profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Salesforce
profile.summary:
I love building things. Sometimes that's meant starting with a clear vision, sometimes not. Either way, I love the challenge of creating solutions to solve problems.

I pride myself on the ability to assume various responsibilities whenever needed. I've had the opportunity to architect and engineer solutions from beginning to end, design architectures from requirements, and establish development policies and procedures for others.

I have also been able to work with various technologies: the Microsoft stack with C# as well as more recently my role centers around the Salesforce platform, specifically the Service and Experience Cloud features. I also have a passion for building tools and development utilities; everything from IDE enhancements to automation for DevSecOps.

I've actively engaged in various volunteering opportunities, the most involved being with OpenForService, a formal local-to-Indianapolis non-profit whose mission was to promote businesses open to everyone. My work there allowed me to explore many new technical aspects including publishing mobile applications from idea-to-production for both iOS and Android, as well as the web.

positions.title: Sharepoint Developer
positions.description:
Lead development efforts for internal collaboration and workflow-based projects on the SharePoint 2013 platform.

* Develop SharePoint server-side components using C#.
* Develop various client-side components using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Help develop business requirements for internal collaboration projects.
* Develop workflow solutions for internal business processes.
* Maintain SharePoint infrastructure and develop administration guidelines.
positions.insights: Microsoft SQL Server, JavaScript and +1 skill

positions.title: Sr. Application Developer
positions.description:
Led efforts to build solutions fulfilling various enterprise-level initiatives including facility acquisition and implementation of new platforms.

* Built and maintained high priority clinical and non-clinical systems integrations.
* Engineered, developed, and maintained data-driven components of public websites.
* Engineered, developed, and maintained mobile applications and backend support infrastructure.
* Configured and maintained PCI-compliant web infrastructure.
* Performed training for 8-member team to introduce emerging technologies, platforms, and development techniques.
positions.insights: Microsoft SQL Server, JavaScript and +1 skill

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Developed applications for the web and Windows desktop platforms to automate tasks and aggregate disparate systems’ data.

* Developed over 20 web form applications to allow users to request various resources from internal departments and teams.
* Engineered a form-generation platform, allowing a more rapid and lower cost development of simple request forms, which hosts over 110 distinct forms and workflow processes.
* Developed over 10 ASP.NET web services to expose line of business data for rapid application development.
positions.insights: Microsoft SQL Server, JavaScript and +1 skill

positions.description:
Performed development and research efforts for various departments and teams.

* Developed Java portal servlets using on the McKesson Physician Portal.
* Developed ASP.NET web form applications for internal business processes.

volunteerExperiences.description:
From the software side, my primary responsibilities have included building the underlying data API as well as the UX responsible for new and existing business contacts to create and/or update their listing within the Open For Service network.

Additionally, I am responsible for the mobile applications for both iOS and Android. We use Ionic to speed up development and maintain a consistent experience across platforms.

Open For Service provides an inclusive network aimed at promoting businesses and organizations that will not turn someone away based on sexual orientation, gender, race, disability, or political/religious affiliation.

Our dev and design team builds and maintains all of the application aspects of the directory including web apps, mobile apps, and data management integrations.
